games.badge: 🐻 Cal Football: Clemson Tigers at Memorial Stadium
games.context_reason: California Golden Bears host Clemson Tigers in Berkeley.
games.insider_tips: Walk up through the UC Berkeley campus or hike Tightwad Hill for panoramic views of San Francisco Bay.
games.result_summary: Clemson defeated California 24-10. California scored first with a 35-yard fumble return. Clemson took the lead in the second quarter with a field goal and a 1-yard rush. California tied the game in the third quarter with a 30-yard field goal, but Clemson pulled ahead with a 65-yard punt return touchdown. Clemson sealed the victory with a 75-yard rushing touchdown in the fourth quarter. The game was played at California Memorial Stadium in Berkeley, California, with an attendance of 41,778.
